title: Beyond Pattern Matching in 3D MLLMs: Part-Level Functional Reasoning for Generalizable Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.32262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D MLLMs recognize objects via pattern matching, which fails when geometrically similar objects require functional reasoning to disambiguate (e.g., dresser vs. wardrobe). Our per-sample Geometric Confusion Score (GCS) exposes this failure: baseline accuracy is 33.7% on ModelNet40's most ambiguous 20% versus 84.0% on its least ambiguous 20%. We identify a function-as-annotation pattern, in which functional language decorates a known identity instead of supporting inference, and hypothesize that reversing this information flow should concentrate improvements on the most ambiguous samples. PFIR (Part-level Functional Inference for Recognition) reverses that flow. Built on PartNeXt part segmentation, its data pipeline produces 507K QA pairs with functional CoTs (geometry $\to$ function $\to$ identity), and its progressive curriculum culminates in dual-objective GRPO: strict functional reasoning and descriptive grounding for Objaverse's div

translated_title: 超越模式匹配的3D多模态大语言模型：面向可泛化识别的部件级功能推理
translated_abstract: 3D多模态大语言模型（3D MLLMs）通过模式匹配来识别物体，当几何形状相似的物体需要功能推理才能消歧时会失效（例如五斗柜与衣柜）。我们提出的逐样本几何混淆分数揭示了这一缺陷：在ModelNet40最模糊的20%样本上，基线准确率仅为33.7%，而在最不模糊的20%样本上则高达84.0%。我们识别出一种“功能作为标注”的模式，即功能性语言只是装饰已知的物体身份，而非支持推理过程，并据此假设：逆转这一信息流应能使改进集中于最模糊的样本上。PFIR（面向识别的部件级功能推理）正是实现了这一逆转。该方法基于PartNeXt部件分割构建，其数据流水线生成了50.7万个带有功能性思维链（几何→功能→身份）的问答对，并通过渐进式课程学习最终以双目标GRPO收尾：在Objaverse的多样物体上进行严格的功能推理与描述性 grounding。
tldr: 针对3D多模态大语言模型依赖模式匹配而无法区分几何相似物体的问题，本文提出PFIR方法，通过部件级功能推理构建“几何→功能→身份”的思维链数据，并以双目标GRPO渐进训练，显著提升了对最模糊样本的识别泛化能力。
en_tdlr: PFIR goes beyond pattern matching in 3D MLLMs by introducing part-level functional reasoning—building 507K QA pairs with geometry-to-function-to-identity CoTs and training via dual-objective GRPO—concentrating gains on geometrically ambiguous objects like dressers vs. wardrobes.
